author: ikalmikal
quote: Goated game, still one of the best stories in the franchise. Imagining a story like this from scratch in 1998 is crazy and then they just made the graphics extremely beautiful with a lot of enjoyable fixes to the gameplay.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: ikalmikal
quote: Goy slop and being afraid to admit it because you waited 13 years is crazy. Red dead redemption 2 is still better than this doo doo ass game and its okay to cope because if I waited through all delays and still got a mid game that basically looks like any other triple A game Id be pretending really hard that this was generational. Hopefully you enjoy kissing the wall at the end of the game.
